description: This file defines the ReducedWindowedDStream class, a specialized Spark Streaming DStream that performs windowed reduction operations with support for inverse reduction and filtering.

classes.name: ReducedWindowedDStream
classes.description: A Spark Streaming DStream that performs windowed reduction with support for inverse reduction and filtering.

methods.name: windowDuration
methods.description: Returns the window duration for the stream.

methods.name: dependencies
methods.description: Returns the list of dependencies for this DStream, which is the reducedStream.

methods.name: slideDuration
methods.description: Returns the slide duration for the windowed stream.

methods.name: parentRememberDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration for which parent RDDs are remembered.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Persists the DStream and its reduced stream with the specified storage level.

methods.name: checkpoint
methods.description: Sets checkpoint interval for the DStream.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Computes the RDD for the current valid time, performing windowed reduction with optional filtering.
